5G Traffic Congestion & Route Optimization

Traffic-flow profiling, congestion-zone detection and rule-based routing recommendations from the supplied telecom dataset.

Scope note: This dataset has no timestamps, unique base-station/gateway IDs, geographic coordinates or source-destination paths. The dashboard therefore analyses node types and service categories; it does not claim actual peak-hour detection, geographic zones or mathematically optimal end-to-end routes.

Rule-based routing policy

High congestion or Fault: avoid the affected node and evaluate an alternate gateway/path, subject to capacity and policy checks.
Moderate congestion: consider shifting traffic only when an alternate path has verified spare capacity.
Low congestion and Normal: retain the current path and continue monitoring.
Prioritize latency-sensitive services for monitoring; service labels are used as provided in the source data.

Congestion score is an exploratory composite indicator (latency 40%, packet loss 30%, jitter 20%, normalized flow volume 10%). It is a project-defined ranking metric, not a telecom-standard KPI or operator-grade routing engine.
